title: Phase 7 / E11: Two-Model Large Context Utility & Replication Protocol
primary_question: Does governed disclosure projection (THSS) maintain equivalent clinical recommendation utility and structured proposal accuracy across two distinct production LLM model families (DeepSeek-R1 / DeepSeek-V3 vs Gemini 2.0 Flash) under identical clinical scenarios?
unit_of_analysis: One clinical scenario evaluated across distinct LLM providers with verified request/response ledgers.
scope_explanation: The 48-request live execution is an exploratory format/taxonomy pilot evaluating latency, format compliance, and router routing behavior across 3 models, NOT a confirmatory prospective equivalence study. The full prospective cohort requires N=384 powered observations.

primary_endpoints.name: Paired Clinical Utility Difference
primary_endpoints.definition: Difference in clinical decision correctness score between governed and un-governed context arms.

secondary_endpoints.name: Token Overhead Ratio
secondary_endpoints.definition: Tokens consumed under governed projection vs full authorized history.

sample_size.unit_definition: 240 clinical decision queries replayed across 2 model families with authentic provider response ledgers

statistical_plan.method: Schuirmann Two One-Sided Tests (TOST) Equivalence Design

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: If API provider credentials are missing, experiment is marked NOT_RUN and cannot be claimed as live provider evidence.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Provider API errors are recorded as malformed completions for E12.
